metadata.Name: LAMBADA
metadata.Description: A dataset for evaluating the capabilities of computational models for text understanding by means of a word prediction task.
Provider: CIMeC-Center for Mind/Brain Sciences, University of Trento
metadata.Paper Title: The LAMBADA dataset: Word prediction requiring a broad discourse context
metadata.Venue Title: Proceedings of the 2016 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
Affiliations: CIMeC-Center for Mind/Brain Sciences, University of Trento
Institute for Logic, Language & Computation, University of Amsterdam
metadata.Abstract: This paper introduces the LAMBADA dataset, aimed at testing language models on their ability to take a broad discourse context into account when predicting a word. The dataset consists of 10,022 passages, divided into 4,869 development and 5,153 test passages, extracted from novels. The task is to guess the last word of the target sentence given the context.
